name: 31 (Scat)
description: 31 (Scat) is a knock game. Get 31 points in one suit (A=11, face=10, number=face value) or highest three-card hand. Draw one, discard one. Knock when confident; lowest hand loses a life. Blitz: 31 in three cards declared immediately; others lose a life. Last player with lives wins.

content.text: 31 (Scat) is a knock game. Get 31 points in one suit (A=11, face=10, number=face value) or highest three-card hand. Draw one, discard one. Knock when confident; lowest hand loses a life. Blitz: 31 in three cards declared immediately; others lose a life. Last player with lives wins.

Probably descended from the 15th-century Italian gambling game trente et un; later popular in France, England and Ireland. The modern 31 / Scat variant is widely played in America and Britain under names like Blitz, Cadillac and Ride the Bus.
Standard 52-card deck. Aces count 11, court cards 10, other cards face value. Dutch variant (Eenendertigen) uses a 32-card pack (7 and above).
3 cards each; one card up for discard; rest stock.

items.text: California Quick: Fast-running home game variant where ties for lowest hand during a knock can cost the knocker two lives, and an opening knock on the first turn ('knocking out of the gate') ends the round immediately.
Banking: Banked version where everyone antes to a central pot and a special three-card widow can be exchanged with; highest hand or blitz (exact 31) wins the pot instead of simply losing lives.
Dollar bill: American scoring variant where each player tracks lives by folding the corners of a banknote; losing a life folds a corner and the last player with an unfolded bill wins the stake.
